# Authentic Legacy SSCV2 Fixtures

These immutable fixtures were produced by released Secure String Cipher
writers, not by the current development writer. They contain only deterministic
synthetic bytes and use the public fixture-only passphrase
`Fixture-Only-Password-2026!`.

- `file-v4.ssc` was generated by release `v1.2.10` at commit
  `f7e3fc797e737ddfdd2a27d28cafec6dc5d710cb`.
- `file-v5.ssc` was generated by release `v1.3.0` at commit
  `f7ff04c4d5a0adc0cbdc3cb841d5048f2f14dcac`.
- Both producers ran in disposable detached worktrees with their own locked
  dependencies under CPython 3.14.7 on macOS 26.5.1 arm64.
- The public `encrypt_file()` API was called without modifying either released
  writer.

`payload.bin` includes every byte value, invalid UTF-8, mixed line endings,
deterministic non-repeating blocks, and repeated data. Its 1,094,205 bytes
exceed four historical 256 KiB chunks, so both fixtures exercise streaming.
`manifest.json` records exact commands, provenance, sizes, and SHA-256 hashes.

Tests must never regenerate or rewrite these files. Any replacement is a
deliberate compatibility-maintenance operation requiring new provenance and
review.
